card.name: Missed-dose wording: as soon as, next
card.fires_on: The word "as" in "as soon as" and "next" in "at the next scheduled time" in missed-dose instructions. Also fires on "lower" in a recipe's oven rack step.

modes.label: Missed dose instructions
modes.description: "as" in "as soon as" or "next" in "next scheduled time" after a missed dose.
